<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation breach:</strong> India&#x27;s retail inflation rose to 4.38% in June, exceeding the RBI’s 4% median target for the first time in 16 months, driven by higher food and fuel costs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory enforcement:</strong> The Supreme Court upheld SEBI’s penalty against Kotak AMC, ruling that investor profit is not a valid defense for regulatory breaches in debt investment cases.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Trade deficit expansion:</strong> India’s trade deficit widened to $30.43 billion in June as imports surged, adding further pressure to the macroeconomic outlook.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical impact on assets:</strong> Escalating West Asia tensions have pushed crude oil prices higher, leading to a slide in the Indian rupee to a one-month low and dampening domestic equity sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxQVkJKcm0xZFVqOFpZTHZoMFVFMlJsTE00aHh4a0EzSjQ2dW0tQml2bnhxRml1dEJmd3VTelQ2YURtSDVKamxjNWdiY3ctclpDWmVIWUxyWkhPbnNlaVV6QUp2eFNLWldIVFE1V3NOWURfNlNYeF95SV9SV0pncFhzNUdxdm1hSlFsVzdzemw5YWFLRldlVExNVlJDU1BoYi10VGs1Zm1CUjBrS1JQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBjZUtYV1NkV0I3VlFVc2JmS3FTLVJzanhkaS1hQkZENTZFZ3BpWkhGQnMyVGdTb2REUE5JQ1ZvT2ZGRFdkSG9oTm9WbUtVcjNjRkk4cXV2QS1mQTlYVUV0Mko5ekpIMGxqOFVLMzVXQ3MxOEEyMUJQZWdVUDNEZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
